// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-IMPORT-ALLOWLIST
// The near miss the PR5 @/lib/mailHmac widening invites. @/lib/mailHmac is on
// the allowlist because it is a pure HMAC helper with no Prisma access.
// @/lib/mailSuppressionSync is NOT, and must never be: it holds
// db.mailSuppression.upsert(), and permitting it here would be the
// OPS-MUTATION-MODULE bypass in an import list.
import { runMailSuppressionSync } from "@/lib/mailSuppressionSync";

export async function syncNow(db: unknown) {
  return runMailSuppressionSync(db as never, () => null);
}
